subtitle: A mercenary’s ambition

body: The Last Story is a Wii role-playing game directed by Hironobu Sakaguchi, with music by Nobuo Uematsu. Zael belongs to a band of mercenaries and dreams of becoming a knight. Work brings the group to Lazulis Island, where personal ambitions become entangled with power, conflict and a world in decline. His relationship with Calista provides a central thread through the adventure. The game gives this fantasy story a more immediate physical setting through real-time battles and the presence of companions around its protagonist.

Zael’s Gathering ability makes nearby enemies focus on him, buying time for his companions to act without interruption. That turns drawing danger into a useful role within the party. Commands allow the player to direct allies, while spells leave elemental circles on the ground. Walking through one can give a weapon its element; later, Zael can diffuse a circle to spread its effect. Positioning therefore matters for more than avoiding an attack: it determines who is protected and how the group can use its magic.

Zael can take cover behind objects, breaking an enemy’s line of sight, and use a crossbow from an over-the-shoulder view. Aiming at an opponent reveals information about its abilities and weaknesses. Destructible parts of the scenery offer further ways to influence a fight. Between missions, Lazulis City provides shops, side quests and an arena where the party can improve and earn rewards. These different activities give the mercenaries practical work to do around the island, beyond following the central story.
